syllabus_info.syllabus_name: Experiential Entrepreneurship 2 - Trải nghiệm khởi nghiệp 2
syllabus_info.time_allocation:
Study hour (150h) =
'-Self-paced online learning: 15 hours
- Learning face-to-face with an instructor: 10 sessions (1 session/week x 10
                                    weeks; 2,25 hrs/session)
- Guest speakers' Sharing - Seminars: 3 sessions (2,25 hrs/session)
- Mentors' Mentoring: 2 (2,25hr/session). 1-3 additional sessions can be set up
                                    depending on the necessity and on the mentor's avaibility.
- 102h self-study
syllabus_info.description:
In Experiental Entrepreneurship 2, groups of students will develop product/service
                                    for their start-up ideas prepared from Experiental Entrepreneurship 1 and deploy
                                    sales and find real customers for their group's products/services.
There is no mandatory content for this course, just a list of suggested
                                    lectures/talks that students can view to get useful tips and experiences for project
                                    realization.
In addition, there will be seminars and workshops with related topics planned
                                    and implemented each semester according to actual needs and implementation
                                    situation.
syllabus_info.studenttasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of Instructor's Coaching sections, Seminars and
                                    Mentor's Mentoring.
- Students are responsible for doing all exercises and assignments given by the
                                    instructor in class or at home and submitting them on time.
- Students must meet all milestones' requirements.
- Promplty access to the learning material platform https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for
                                    up to date course information.
syllabus_info.tools: - A hall for seminars has a capacity of at least 200 people

sessions.topic:
Week 2
Instructor's coaching
Design for Startups, Part 2
sessions.student_materials:
Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7H-design-for-startups-part-2-sus-2018
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
sessions.student_tasks:
- Follow the instructions and requirements of the Lecturer, review assigned video
                                    lectures

- Modify plan regarding lecturer's comments
- Keep developing product/service

sessions.topic:

sessions.student_tasks:

sessions.topic:
Week 3
Mentoring 1
sessions.student_tasks:
Before mentoring:
Prepare questions
During mentoring: discuss and require guidance from the mentor.
After mentoring:
Put into practice the knowledge and try to deepen it in the project.

sessions.topic:
Week 4
Instructor's coaching
How to Launch (Again and Again)
sessions.student_materials:
Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/6i-how-to-launch-again-and-again
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
sessions.student_tasks:
- Present market analysis and problem statement, give insign information from its
                                    market research
- Present the selected channels for launching.
- Improve the product/service if needed

sessions.topic:
Week 5
Instructor's coaching
How to get your first ten customers?
Oucome 2 presentation
sessions.student_materials:
Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/9h-how-to-get-your-first-ten-customers
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
sessions.student_tasks:
Presents launching situation (channels, methods, cost, market fit, customer target,
                                    primilary feedback,…)

sessions.topic:
Week 5
Mentoring 2 (optional)
sessions.student_tasks: Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.

sessions.topic:
Week 6
Instructor's coaching
How to Get Users and Grow
sessions.student_materials:
Watch video lectures below:
https://www.ycombinator.com/library/7K-how-to-get-users-and-grow-sus-2018
- (Optional) Read book The Lean Startup
sessions.student_tasks:
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels

sessions.topic:
Week 6
Mentoring 3 (optional)
sessions.student_tasks: Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.

Instructor's coaching

sessions.student_tasks:
Prepare the feedback form and send it to at least 20 people. Collect feedback
                                    answers and analyze them.
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels

sessions.topic:
Week 8
Instructor's coaching
How to Set KPIs and Goals
sessions.student_tasks:
Present the feedback analysis and improvement plan if there is.
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels

sessions.topic:
Week 8
Seminar 3
Recommended topics:
How to do market research – Instructor or Guest speaker
MVP and How to Shorten Time-To- Market – Guest speaker
“Startup Fundraising & Venture Investment” – Guest speaker
sessions.student_tasks:
- Attend the seminar
During Seminar:
- Prepare questions for Guest speakers

sessions.topic:
Week 8
Mentoring 4 (optional)
sessions.student_tasks: Acquire the guidance of the mentor and put it into practice.

sessions.topic:
Week 9
Instructor's coaching
Growth for Startups
sessions.student_tasks:
Present the feedback analysis, improvement plan if there is.
Keep improving product/service if needed
Keep launching product/service on selected channels
Prepare the final report

sessions.topic:
Week 9
Mentoring 5
sessions.student_tasks: Prepare the pitch deck

sessions.topic:
Week 10
Evaluate all the groups
1 session offline
sessions.student_tasks: Present the startup project and results

sessions.topic:
Week 11-14
Relaunch & try to approach customers again if previously failed

assessments.grading_guide:
- In class, by instructor
- Students demonstrate the product/service to the class
- Product/service should run well and be market- ready
assessments.note:
See rubric at Material link (Schedule sheet, line1)
Instructor has resposibility to review the group's demonstration for students.

assessments.grading_guide:
- In class, by instructor
- Students need to submit the required document, and do a presentation in class
assessments.note:
See rubric at Material link (Schedule sheet, line1)
Instructor has resposibility to review the group's presentation for students.

assessments.grading_guide:
- In class, by instructor and mentor
- Students need to submit the sales results along with all needed proof to the
                                    instructor
- Students will present their result in class
assessments.note:
See rubric at Material link (Schedule sheet, line1)
Instructor has resposibility to review the group's presentation for students
                                    after graded.
